label: miso27 interchange shape export
definition: (PROBE — REJECTED) miso25 flag set + --interchange-shaping-export-only: shape ONLY the export leg of the priced interchange node to the measured EIA-930 (month x hour-of-day) envelope, leaving imports uncapped (clear on price under the existing seam flow cap). Intent: impose the measured diurnal envelope on exports without over-starving baseload imports. RESULT: WRONG LEVER — net imports got WORSE in all 3 years (model 52.97/39.44/29.66 TWh vs miso25 46.7/32.4/21.4, actual 37.9/23.1/19.0), because shaping the export leg down to the small measured MISO export profile removed the model's balancing exports and pushed NET imports up. Diurnal swing barely moved (peak->trough 4803 MW 2023 vs miso25 4832, actual 1020): the over-deep overnight problem lives on the IMPORT leg, which export-only leaves uncapped, so it cannot fix gap (1). import-hours ~100% all years (vs 98/91/79 actual). Superseded by miso27b (full --interchange-shaping, both legs). energy_reserve_coopt and firm-import-floor stay OFF.
